ManSection.Description:
Constructs a geometric lattice from a list gs of lists of lists giving its ground set (see ).
The entry gs[k] contains all flats of rank k, where each flat is given by the list of the indices of the atoms below it.
The flats are converted into sets of positive integers, the rank of the lattice is the number of levels Length(gs) and the atoms are read off from the first level gs[1].
No check is performed whether gs really defines a geometric lattice.
gap> L:=GeomLattice([[[1],[2],[3]],[[1,2],[1,3],[2,3]],[[1,2,3]]]); <Geometric lattice: 3 atoms, rank 3> gap> LGroundSet(L); [ [ [ 1 ], [ 2 ], [ 3 ] ], [ [ 1, 2 ], [ 1, 3 ], [ 2, 3 ] ], [ [ 1, 2, 3 ] ] ] gap> LCharPoly(L); t^3-3*t^2+3*t-1

ManSection.Description:
Computes multiset invariants of the geometric lattice L.
For each level of the lattice, the function records how many intersections occur with a given number of defining hyperplanes.
Determines, if L is irreducible.
Determines, if L has a generic atom, that is, an element of the ground set such that all hyperplanes containing it are boolean.
Computes the bases of m in L.
Determines the circuit contained in Union(B,[e]).
